cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first club meeting, and I second the minutes. You read them clearly; those speaking lessons I gave you paid off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A motion, yes. I second yours unanimously. You used to need me to prompt a whole sentence; look at you now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unanimity pending Ruth, then. Ask her for her vote, loudly; I taught you to reach the back row, and she's sitting in it.
